documentation.content: A disk on ci-linux-x64 or ci-windows-x64 is more than 85% full. The job-started hook refuses jobs below its free-space floor, so CI jobs on that label may be failing. See infra/ci-runners/README.md in runmat-org/runmat: run the cache report on the VM, then evict lanes or grow the disk.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "gce_instance" AND metric.type = "agent.googleapis.com/disk/percent_used" AND metric.labels.state = "used" AND metadata.user_labels.purpose = "ci-runner"
